purpose: Steaming-teacup candidates and the original blueberry for in-app comparison
status: Retained design candidates; comparison gallery only
usage: Future incorporation into app branding or content awaits an explicit user choice

concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: BetterFlash educational desktop and Android app identity study, one standalone icon.
Style: sleek, modern, professional but gently cartoonish editorial illustration, confident rounded silhouette, bold simple contours and a few broad flat tonal planes. Readable at 24-32 px. No face or anthropomorphism, no emoji style, no tiny details, no gradients, no glows, no drop shadow, no background disk or tile, no decorative stars, no text or letters.
Composition: a single centered steaming teacup, full cup and steam visible, square image, occupy about 85 percent of the available area with balanced clear margins. Actual transparent alpha background. Cream edge accents keep the mark legible against aubergine and paper app themes. Steam is two or three distinct thick rounded rising curved strokes, visibly steam rather than a lid or a hat.
Variant 01 Ceramic: a compact low rounded terracotta ceramic teacup with one sturdy rounded handle on the right, warm amber tea visible as a narrow ellipse, two warm ivory curling steam strokes above. Muted burnt orange and peach body with one broad lighter tone. No saucer. Calm, substantial, optical balance. Steam and cup form a compact unified mark.

Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: original BetterFlash blueberry logo isolated for comparison.
Input image: edit target, the original B1 / Blueberry presentation board.
Extract ONLY the existing single blueberry mark in the center of the supplied image. Preserve its exact asymmetrical silhouette, ivory outline, periwinkle highlight, indigo body, rounded five-lobed calyx, proportions and colors. Do not redesign or add anything. Remove the aubergine background and ALL lettering including B1 / Blueberry and BetterFlash. Return the original blueberry alone on a genuinely transparent alpha background, centered in a square with about 85 percent occupancy and balanced clear margins. No added shadow, no new shapes.
